hooks.text: 献祭身体部位会增加机制与难度，也可积累压力反转为新能力
hooks.excerpt: Each body part sacrificed will add new mechanics and will change the game in a meaningful way. Each sacrifice will increase your stress level, with enough stress you can reverse a sacrifice to gain a new ability instead.
hooks.label: 证据原文片段

hooks.text: 额外奖励竞技场会用特殊规则强迫玩家改变打法
hooks.excerpt: In some arenas you can figh for additional rewards. In such cases, enemies will spawn with a special rule-set, forcing you to strategize and change your play style to complete the rule objective.
hooks.label: 证据原文片段

hooks.text: 武器可改变地图，血液枪以生命作弹药并惩罚失误
hooks.excerpt: Each weapon provides a unique gameplay experience, some can even alter the maps themselves. The gun selection ranges from a simple revolver to a demented gun which consumes your blood for ammo and punishes you each time you miss.
hooks.label: 证据原文片段

opinions.text: 视觉设计对独立开发作品而言非常出色
